v1.target: next-season outcome, raw, pooled across seasons
v1.note: legacy convention; the shipped gate verdicts were established here

v2.target: next-season outcome (within-OUTCOME-season z-score removes the era term)
v2.bootstrap: player-clustered (all of a player's pairs move together), season-stratified (players stratified by first predictor season); 2000 reps, seeded; CIs are wider by design
v2.note: transition-cycle companion; future gates must pre-declare v1 or v2

harness.pair_rule: Y->Y+1 pairs kept only when the OUTCOME season is complete (past Nov 15). Partial-year targets (e.g. mid-2026) are a defect, dropped under BOTH conventions.
harness.predictors: unrounded *_raw model scores (display rounding never enters evals)
interpretation_rules: existing VALIDATED ships STAND even if v2 weakens them; a reversal is flagged to the owner, not auto-reverted
ledgered NO-SHIPs are re-baselined under v2 but never revived by v2 alone
X-R2 / X-S2 flips are not promised

park_factor_provenance.rolling: Savant park-factor indexes are 3-YEAR ROLLING (year=Y covers Y-2..Y), 100 = neutral; the predictor-year index is used
park_factor_provenance.join: park row main_team_id (stringified MLBAM team id) -> int -> the player's StatsAPI season-split team id (cached fa_statsapi_*)
park_factor_provenance.neutral_fallback: multi-team player-seasons (numTeams>1), unknown teams, and venues missing from the park table use the neutral target (candidate == incumbent there); applied to pitchers and hitters alike
park_factor_provenance.hitter_pre2016_note: savant_pf 2012-2015 fetched live from Savant this run (Savant reachable) and cached; HEM+ therefore runs its full family-lab season list

design: Candidate changes ONE thing vs the incumbent skill core: the HR component's empirical-Bayes SHRINK TARGET becomes pool_hr * (1 + s*(index_hr/100 - 1)). Observed counts are never park-adjusted. Candidate pool anchor recomputed so 100 = pool average under the candidate core.

X-R7_rem_plus.candidate: REM+ skill core with the HR shrink target scaled by the predictor-year park: pool_hr * (1 + s*(index_hr/100 - 1))

X-S7_sem_plus.target: -RA9 in year Y+1 (v1 raw pooled; v2 within-outcome-season z)

extreme_park_diagnostic.note: diagnostic only (never a gate); iid bootstrap on the extreme-park subset

X-S7_sem_plus.candidate: plain SEM+ skill core (no GB adjust) with the HR shrink target scaled by the predictor-year park

extreme_park_diagnostic.note: diagnostic only (never a gate); iid bootstrap on the extreme-park subset
